status: bounded opt-in implementation; no general AC1027 or ODA whole-file acceptance claim
authority: ODA DWG v5.4.1 §20.1 object data/string/handle framing and §20.4.54 LAYER references, with class/field/graph profile bounded by the physical AC1027 witness.
problem: A source-backed AC1027 synthetic layer uses a real Global MATERIAL reference and a typed visualstyle null. The previous writer has no opt-in default material graph in this revision, emits untyped nulls, and aligns string/handle framing rather than using the observed exact bit boundaries.
scope: Only callers explicitly opting into the existing default MATERIAL and default plotstyle providers can stage this AC1027 graph. Its layer 0 must be synthesized; an explicitly supplied layer 0 is refused before publication. The graph stages ByBlock, ByLayer and Global with the pre-existing protected handles and graph collision gates. The frame path checks planned identities, exact common preamble, canonical material body and string bits, owner/reactor roles, layer material and plotstyle references, xref and visualstyle null roles, and exact string/handle boundaries. AC1032 remains unsupported for this opt-in; default AC1027 callers do not enter the new path.

physical_source.description: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored a one-LINE DXF; ODA File Converter 27.1 converted it to AC1027 DWG. The original conversion lineage is a separately observed manual join; see p6-ac1027-1032-oda-writer-rejection-2026-11-04.json.

peer: LibreDWG 0.14 independently decodes 64 identical non-identity/frame fields for each source and generated ByBlock, ByLayer and Global material, a matching MATERIAL class profile, NOD→material dictionary→three entries, HEADER→dictionary and ByLayer, LAYER→Global, and role-4 owner/reactor joins. Source and generated prehandle boundaries are 743/743/727 bits and detached string lengths 136/136/120 bits. Inferred terminal padding is computed from observed frame and handle lengths; its actual bit value is not established by this peer audit. Native AC1027 material callbacks retain raw payload rather than claiming complete typed semantics.
oda_diagnostic: The final writer output is byte-identical to the scratch graph2 control except for diagnostic file-header byte 0x0b, changed from 0 to 6 in the latter. This byte is not application-maintenance byte 0x12 and is not changed by the candidate. ODA audit reports no LAYER warning for graph2 but reports 20 other warnings, fails at VPORT, requires recovery and produces no DXF. Earlier graph0 (old alignment) has 21 warnings including LAYER, while graph1 (exact LAYER boundary only) has 20 and no LAYER warning. These are diagnostics, not valid whole-file exports or independent proof of material rendering.
frame_observations: Source LAYER prehandle boundary is 139 bits with a 26-bit string; candidate boundary is 155 with a 42-bit string because the existing writer retains its TU terminator. Candidate material boundaries and source match for these one-byte handles. Source and candidate material names/semantics are independently decoded by LibreDWG; frame occurrence tests verify actual rebased handle roles and bit positions.
rollback: Each synthesized LAYER frame catches one-shot frame allocation failures, truncates partial bytes and restores map/identity/generation state, clears its current receipt and latches failure. The existing material graph compound checkpoint handles source-profile validation failures, injected exceptions and one-shot allocation failures, and tests same-writer retry. Its rollback uses allocating container copies: persistent allocation failure during rollback is not qualified. Material and plotstyle are separate transactions; no combined all-or-nothing direct-writer claim is made. Public facade output failure preserves an existing destination and allows a fresh same-facade retry.
compatibility: A default AC1027 LINE output without material opt-in remains byte-identical to the pre-candidate output (SHA-256 b6cb50035e1e25ac161f3e214b3bdc07f1764bc2f6bdedd7d7643a7cf1c3a9d2). Existing AC1021/AC1024 controls remain exercised. No public class layout, ABI or method signature is changed.

validation.details: Default graph collision controls, missing plot opt-in and supplied-layer sentinel refusal/retry, previous versions and AC1032 refusal, exact LAYER and Global receipt occurrences, malformed material body/string/handle refusal and retry, dictionary-stage exception, one-shot allocation sweeps for the material transaction and protected layer frame, fixture-free peer audit negatives, native readback.

next_step: Investigate remaining VPORT and other ODA warnings with producer-backed source spans and bounded controls. Do not promote the opt-in to general AC1027 writer interoperability without a clean independent output and full graph/geometry validation.
